planSteps.description: Open RoomTrace at the test target URL.
Open the clearly labeled sample journal.
Start a new observation from the journal navigation.
Choose Move-in and the Kitchen room.
Enter a unique observation title and note.
Fetch the public synthetic /test-fixtures/arrival.png bytes and attach them through the Original photos file input.
Save the observation, reload the page, and reopen the record.
Assert that the saved note and original photo are still available after reload.
